G1090108.description: Handrema is the smallest village in the commune of Bandraboua on Mayotte. In 2007, its population was 1,485.

G1090119.description: main village in the French municipality of Bandraboua in Mayotte

G1090126.description: Mtsamboro (French pronunciation: [mtsɑ̃bɔʁo] ) is a small fishing town and commune in northwest Mayotte, a French overseas department in the Indian Ocean. Its population according to the 2017 census is 7,705.

G1090161.description: M'Tsangamouji (French pronunciation: [mtsɑ̃ɡamuʒi] ) is a commune in the French overseas department of Mayotte, in the Indian Ocean.

G1090225.description: Koungou (French pronunciation: [kuŋɡu] ) is the second largest commune in the French overseas department of Mayotte, in the Indian Ocean, after the capital Mamoudzou. It is composed of six villages: Majicavo Lamir, Majicavo Koropa, Koungou, Trévani, Kangani and Longoni.

G1090242.description: Mtsapéré (French pronunciation: [mtsapeʁe]) is a settlement in the French commune of Mamoudzou, Mayotte.

G1090308.description: Ongojou is a village in the commune of Dembéni on Mayotte. It is known for its rich history of wine making.

G1090322.description: Chiconi (French pronunciation: [ʃikɔni] ) is a commune in the French overseas department of Mayotte, in the Indian Ocean.

G1090356.description: Iloni is a village in the commune of Dembeni on Mayotte Island.

G1090415.description: Chirongui (French pronunciation: [ʃiʁɔ̃ɡi] ) is a commune in the French overseas department of Mayotte, in the Indian Ocean.

G1090434.description: Dapani is a village in the commune of Bandrele on Mayotte. It is located near the Pointes et plages de Saziley et Charifou protected area on the south-east of Mayotte.

G921707.description: Pamandzi (French pronunciation: [pamɑ̃dzi] ) is a commune in the French overseas department of Mayotte, in the Indian Ocean. The commune of Pamandzi is located on the small island of Petite-Terre (or Pamanzi), off the main island of Mayotte.

G921815.description: Mamoudzou (French pronunciation: [mamudzu] ; Momojou) is the capital city of Mayotte, a French overseas region and department in the Indian Ocean. Mamoudzou is the most populated commune (municipality) of Mayotte.

G921900.description: Dzaoudzi (French pronunciation: [dzaudzi] ) is a commune in the French overseas department of Mayotte, in the Indian Ocean. The commune of Dzaoudzi (sometimes called Dzaoudzi-Labattoir [dzaudzi labatwaʁ]), made up of the twin towns of Dzaoudzi and Labattoir, is located on the small island of Petite-Terre (or Pamanzi).

G922015.description: Acoua (French pronunciation: [akwa] ) is a commune in the French overseas department of Mayotte, in the Indian Ocean.
